reviewed: CountMinSketch::Create returns a heap allocation whose class operator delete calls free, so std::shared_ptr default destruction matches production ownership. Separate old/new objects remain live, making pointer replacement observable.
TEqWidthHistogram default constructor supplies one Int32 bucket, meeting constructor/estimator invariants. Shared estimator ownership retains the underlying histogram.
TEqHeightHistogram accepts an empty finalized protobuf by returning before bucket validation; two distinct owned reader objects are sufficient identity witnesses. No histogram estimate is requested.

All five single-column fields and all four multi-column fields are observed through the actual ApplyColumnStatistics/MergeColumnStatistics branch: replacement, absent-field preservation, optional zero payloads, vector/type updates and cache-map identity.
std::optional<double> truth checks in the production merger test presence, so incoming zero values must replace nonzero cached NDV and absent HLL; the checks distinguish absent from zero.

The ready promise is retained; ApplyColumnStatistics only requires readiness and does not clear SharedState, so repeated applications use the actual same cache and response owner. Replacing response maps exercises both omission and repeated payload semantics.

The patch changes only the dormant generator; its shared prelude adds a real public histogram header. Q19 generated-source identity will also change and is already subject to OA06 current-source binding.
scope_limits: This extension checks existing cached entries. Initially absent table entries, new-only columns and issue-bearing responses are not added by this patch; retain the separate coverage requirements.
The fixture does not establish histogram selectivity accuracy, SQL semantics, full RBO optimization quality or actual compile/link success.
